rules.description:
httpx.Client was removed in favor of HTTPX2 as the default HTTP client. Applications using custom HTTPX clients, transports, or configuration objects must migrate to their HTTPX2 equivalents or use the temporary, runtime-only legacy HTTPX escape hatch.
Validation concerns: This migration type requires manual handling. No concrete replacement API has been established.
rules.evidence: HTTPX2 is now the default HTTP client, and httpx is no longer installed automatically. Applications using custom HTTPX clients, transports, or configuration objects must migrate to their HTTPX2 equivalents or use the temporary, runtime-only legacy HTTPX escape hatch.
